mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.2% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC for UNRATE threshold signal is below 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline in the current month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for interaction signal is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a weakening manufacturing sector that precedes a recession, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during late-cycle expansion when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC for INDPRO signal in late-cycle is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP growth (GDPC1) signals strong economic expansion that boosts corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 rises, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 2.5% for two consecutive months, it signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC for CPIAUCSL threshold signal is below 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansion, a sustained increase in non-farm payrolls above 200,000 per month signals strong labor market growth that accelerates consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods during early-cycle expansion when PAYEMS growth exceeds 200k, or Rank IC for PAYEMS signal in early-cycle is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and year-over-year CPI inflation above 2.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening amid persistent inflation, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or Rank IC for interaction signal is below 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.
